description: Trafic annuel entrant par station (année 2014) sur le réseau ferré RATP is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données détaille le trafic des entrants directs sur le réseau ferré RATP en 2014. Les « entrants directs » sont exclusivement les voyageurs provenant de la voie publique ou du réseau SNCF entrant sur le réseau de transport RATP en validant un titre de transport valide. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Fréquentation & Statistiques. Its keywords are Trafic, RATP. The portal shows 2015-10-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
